packageRules.description: Dependency updates are build changes, never features or fixes in the release notes.
Chromium itself: one pull request of its own, never merged automatically, to try by hand before merging. The workspace's Cargo.toml is CEF's one version.
prBodyNotes: CEF comes with Chromium's proprietary codecs from amenophis/cef-codecs: build this version there first, or `mise run cef` fails.
